split: test split (stratified, seed 42) — identical to FinBERT baseline; half used for temperature fit, half for eval
verdict: Zero-shot Laya trails the finance-specialized stack by 16 accuracy points and is ~10x slower than FinBERT on CPU (393ms vs ~30ms for a 110M model), which is the deployment target (jury laptops, CPU-only). Main failure mode: poor financial-tone judgment (35/120 neutral headlines classified negative). The model card itself positions base Laya as "a fast base to specialise, not a zero-shot decision engine". Decision: keep FinBERT for bulk sentiment and the small-LLM layer for per-entity extraction; revisit fine-tuned Laya only as a gate model if event-type labeled data is collected. Kernel: sachingoyal27/laya-sentiment-spike v4.
